The '''"Holoscreen" shield generator''' was a powerful [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] produced by [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] for use in [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].
